name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Between Crappie and Pike, one goes with Cedarmere and the other with Mossbank.
Mabel goes with either Bass or Grayreach (but not both).
Either Boone goes with Cedarmere or someone in the Pike Family goes with Cedarmere.
Boone, Gus, and Birchpool go with Bass, Crappie, and Perch, in some order.
